requirements.title: Service discovery offer timing
requirements.text: The platform shall announce every provided SOME/IP service instance using an initial offer delay drawn from the configured [100 ms, 200 ms] window, and shall enter the repetition phase afterwards.

requirements.title: Client find behaviour for required services
requirements.text: A required service instance shall issue FindService entries until the service is seen, honouring the configured initial find delay.

requirements.title: Event group multicast distribution
requirements.text: Notification events shall be distributed to subscribed clients over the configured multicast endpoint 239.0.0.1:5555.

requirements.title: RPC transport endpoint
requirements.text: Platform RPC traffic shall use the TCP endpoint declared in the execution manifest (127.0.0.1:8080).

requirements.title: Function group state transitions
requirements.text: Execution Management shall support the MachineFG function group with the states Off and StartUp, and shall reject transitions to undeclared states.

requirements.title: Deterministic client cycle activation
requirements.text: A deterministic application shall be able to wait for the next activation cycle and obtain a reproducible random seed per cycle.

requirements.title: Machine power mode notification
requirements.text: State Management shall expose the current power mode to subscribed applications through the notifier interface.

requirements.title: Alive supervision of platform processes
requirements.text: Platform Health Management shall report a supervision failure when fewer than the expected alive indications are reported within the configured reference cycle.

requirements.title: UDS request routing
requirements.text: The diagnostic manager shall route an incoming UDS request to the handler registered for its SID and shall answer 0x7F/0x11 when no handler exists.

requirements.title: Read vehicle data by identifier
requirements.text: ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) shall serve the DIDs for average speed (0xF50D), fuel amount (0xF52F) and external temperature (0xF546) from the connected-vehicle resource cache.

requirements.title: ECU reset request
requirements.text: ECUReset (0x11) shall be accepted only in a non-safety-critical machine state and shall confirm the reset before execution.

requirements.title: Software download over UDS
requirements.text: RequestDownload (0x34), TransferData (0x36) and RequestTransferExit (0x37) shall implement a block-sequence-counter protected download.

requirements.title: Vehicle announcement
requirements.text: The DoIP entity shall emit the configured number of vehicle announcement messages after link-up, carrying the configured EID/GID and logical address.

requirements.title: Telematics communication loss DTC
requirements.text: Loss of communication with the telematic control module shall set DTC U0198 after the configured debounce time.
